subject.title: fix(heartbeat): stop reporting success after tool failures

question: Should OpenClaw ship `observeToolTerminal` as the additive public agent-harness seam and adopt unresolved mutating-tool failures as terminal heartbeat failures across embedded, Codex, and Copilot runtimes?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but it commits a plugin SDK contract and changes observable heartbeat status, retry, and bookkeeping semantics; automation cannot approve that compatibility boundary.

options.title: Approve the shared contract
options.body: Accept the optional observer as the canonical harness seam and land after the current head is rebased or refreshed with required checks green.

options.title: Narrow the SDK surface
options.body: Revise the design to keep terminal observation private or internal before landing the heartbeat behavior change.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared contract
recommendation.body: Accept the optional observer as the canonical harness seam and land after the current head is rebased or refreshed with required checks green.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex terminal-lifecycle ownership makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the cross-runtime contract decision.
